thread.title: How will the FAANGs perform in 2019? - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Yoel Minkoff
title: How will the FAANGs perform in 2019? - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
It's been a mixed year for the so-called FAANG stocks. The group expanded their reach into other industries and partnerships, but faced widespread calls for regulation, industry privacy scandals and fallout from rocky trade negotiations with China.
YTD movement: FB -26% , AMZN +28% , AAPL -7% , NFLX +39% , ( GOOG , GOOGL ) -3% .
Where are each of the FAANG stocks heading in 2019? How will the group fare as a whole?
Discuss in the comments section below.
